collection_method: HTML extraction from official Telangana State Portal calendar pages.
classification_handling: Original HTML classes are retained as published. The values 'fix' and 'opt' have not been independently verified as legal holiday classifications.
limitations: Agreement between two extraction methods does not independently establish source completeness.
Independent verification against government holiday orders remains pending.
The 2025 calendar has 49 extracted records; the difference from other years has not been independently explained.
The original HTML classification labels have not been independently verified against legal notifications.
